aspect: There is no end date to plan against
description: Care need generally escalates, and the only timeline is the one nobody wants to estimate.

aspect: Nobody assigns it and somebody does it
description: It falls to whoever lives closest, works most flexibly, or says no least easily. That is not a decision anyone made.

aspect: The cost is earnings that never arrive
description: Reduced hours, declined promotions, early retirement, pension contributions foregone - invisible because it is income that never existed.
Every second weekend for four years. He does not take the job in another city. Nobody asks him to stay; he simply never applies.
energy_note: A decision made so gradually it never felt like one.

description: The end of caring is a bereavement and a sudden void of structure at once, usually after the carer's own networks have thinned.
